# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are provided for the latest development branch.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| main | ✅ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open a public GitHub issue.

Instead:

- Contact the maintainers privately.
- Include a detailed description of the issue.
- Provide steps to reproduce if possible.
- Include any relevant logs or proof of concept.

We will acknowledge reports as soon as possible and work toward a responsible resolution before public disclosure.

Thank you for helping improve the security of Kampigo.
